description: This file defines a React component-based notification system with context management, including hooks for different notification types and specific use-cases like DID and VC notifications. It manages notification state, rendering, animations, and external integrations like buttons and cards.

methods.name: useNotifications
methods.description: Custom hook to access notification context, throwing error if used outside provider.

methods.name: NotificationProvider
methods.description: React component that provides notification management functions and state to its children.
